meta_description: Dominic King Plumbing and Bathrooms in Preston. Emergency plumbing, boiler repairs, bathroom installation, and heating. Fast response, fair prices.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Emergency Callouts Available
hero_subhead: Burst pipe at 11pm? We're here. Same-day repairs, emergency heating fixes, and full bathroom installations across Preston.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Bathroom Services Across Preston
services_subhead: From emergency leaks to full bathroom overhauls, we handle every job with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, frozen pipes, and blocked drains fixed fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to be with you in under an hour, 24/7.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Gas Safe registered. Quick fault diagnosis, same-day repairs, and full heating system overhauls. Reduce your energy bills with a modern efficient boiler.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: Complete bathroom renovations from tiles to taps. We manage the lot — plumbing, electrics sign-off, and final finishes to a high standard.

services.title: Radiator & Central Heating
services.desc: Leaking radiators, bleeding, and full heating system maintenance. Keep your home warm all winter without the stress or unexpected breakdowns.

services.title: Tap & Leak Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps, leaking joints, and water damage sorted quickly. Small jobs done right, stopping wasted water and your bill climbing.

services.title: Water Heater Service & Repair
services.desc: Unvented cylinders, combi boilers, and immersion repairs. Get reliable hot water back on demand without the stress.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing cowboys overcharge my neighbours.
about_para_1: Dominic King Plumbing was founded in 2008 with one goal: deliver honest, fast plumbing to Preston families without the inflated bills. Over 18 years, we've built a solid reputation by showing up on time, fixing things properly the first time, and treating every home and every customer with respect.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe registered and carry all common parts on the van so we can diagnose and fix most jobs the same day. Our customers come back because they know Dominic answers the phone, we quote fairly, and we finish when we say we will. No surprises, no cowboys, just honest local plumbing.
reviews_heading: What Preston Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Pipe burst on Boxing Day morning and I was in a right panic. Dominic came out within the hour, found the problem straight away, and had it fixed before lunch. Professional, friendly, and the price was fair. Absolute lifesaver.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a new bathroom fitted start to finish. The lads were tidy, punctual, and Dominic checked everything himself before signing off. Looks brilliant and hasn't leaked once. Proper job.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Called about a faulty boiler on a Friday afternoon. Dominic diagnosed it, explained what was needed, and fitted a replacement the following Monday. No faffing about, no hidden charges. Heating works perfectly now and my bills are down.
reviews.author: Robert H.
